## Overview

Continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) describes an approach to software
development involving short, iterative cycles with automated testing and
release. This module shows how building and publishing container images can be
automated with GitHub workflows for software releases that are reliable,
reusable and identifiable.

We discuss container-specific aspects of testing, which complement the unit and
integration tests of software covered in the Testing course earlier in this
series. The module ends with best practices for containerising research
software, and a brief survey of related container technologies you are likely to encounter in research.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you will:

- Have created a GitHub workflow that builds and publishes a container image
  automatically
- Understand how testing may fit in before and after an image is built
- Be able to set image metadata and package versions dynamically using build
  argument
- Know best practices for developing and sharing research software with
  containers
- Recognise the use case for related tools: Podman Compose, Apptainer and Kubernetes
